body.x: DJI participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced a gimbal ‘Ronin 2’ with excellent functions and ‘OSMO Mobile2’.

Ronin 2, a representative product of DJI, can be equipped with more many kinds of cameras thanks to upgraded high-torque motor, endures heavy wind and inertial force when mounted in a car, and has strong durability in flight. It also boasts a significantly enhanced intelligence. From smoothness control to smart functions suitable for studio photography, it is useful for taking panoramic and time-laps photographs. Especially through the integrated power system, it works smoothly without many cables unlike the previous model, it minimizes the users’ inconvenience.

OSMO Mobile 2, a handheld smartphone, is a designed to enable shooting instantly, with lightweight design, smart features and a long battery life. Users can make great videos using various shooting techniques such as time-lapse, hyper-lapse, paranoma, and zoom control. The OSMO Mobile 2 weights just 485g and is capable of 15 hours of continuous shooting.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
